feature.action_mapping_note: Canonical action is advertised by the simulator.

intent.user_goal: Use Start Sprint in a realistic Jira workflow.
intent.transcript_requirement: Match only when the video/transcript requires this visible interaction or result.
intent.when_to_use: Use when observed UI behavior corresponds to Start Sprint.
intent.when_not_to_use: Do not substitute a related feature without matching visible behavior.

ui_contract.required_visibility: Lesson use must produce a visible software-owned state.
ui_contract.before_state: Package baseline plus prior cumulative actions.
ui_contract.interaction: Invoke a canonical action using parameters confirmed in the engine handler.
ui_contract.after_state: The named surface/control/result must visibly reflect the interaction.
ui_contract.focus_and_scroll: Keep active control/result visible without shaking.
ui_contract.explanation_rule: Use the single parent-owned global explanation card.

input_contract.parameters: Inspect the exact engine handler before writing action.data; never invent parameters.

state_contract.user_preferences: Persistent user layout/theme settings survive replay unless explicitly changed.

transcript_matching.decision_rule: Match visible interaction + expected result, then verify canonical action.

lesson_authoring.missing_feature_rule: If behavior is absent, upgrade the master simulator before creating the lesson.

replay_and_quality.visual_fidelity_note: Catalog coverage does not prove pixel-perfect fidelity.

maintenance.generated_baseline_note: Detailed baseline from current manifest and engine action surfaces; manual enrichment is allowed.
